heading: Grants for AIDS housing information and coordination services
lead: Grants under this section may only be used for the following activities:

tree.heading: Housing information services
tree.text: To provide (or contract to provide) counseling, information, and referral services to assist eligible persons to locate, acquire, finance, and maintain housing and meet their housing needs.

tree.heading: Resource identification
tree.text: To identify, coordinate, and develop housing assistance resources (including conducting preliminary research and making expenditures necessary to determine the feasibility of specific housing-related initiatives) for eligible persons.

notes.text: Amendments1992—Pars. (1), (2). Pub. L. 102–550 substituted “eligible persons” for “individuals with acquired immunodeficiency syndrome or related diseases”.

ancestors.heading: HOUSING OPPORTUNITIES FOR PERSONS WITH AIDS
